lines.en: label chapthree5:
scene postapocalypsekaraoke1
The rest of the day proceeds as if nothing traumatic or worrying ever happened at all.
lines.zh: 这一天剩下的时间就这么过去了,仿佛什么创伤、什么让人担心的事都从未发生过。

lines.en: It’s just me, two girls who recently made it through the end of the world-
lines.zh: 只有我,两个刚刚熬过世界末日的女孩——

lines.en: And two other girls who, at this point in time, seem to care more about what songs they’re going to sing than the state of the universe or what it means to be alive.
lines.zh: 还有另外两个女孩,她们此刻似乎更在乎自己要唱什么歌,而不是宇宙的状态,或者活着意味着什么。

lines.en: But I guess I can’t blame them for that considering how, up until a few hours ago, they {i}potentially{/i} didn’t even exist.
lines.zh: 不过我猜这怪不得她们,毕竟就在几小时前,她们{i}说不定{/i}根本就不存在。

lines.en: And I say “potentially” because my recent run-in with a half-invisible Maya has cast a shadow on all that I understand about world resets (Which wasn’t very much to begin with).
lines.zh: 我说「说不定」,是因为我最近和半隐形的 Maya 的那场遭遇,给我对世界重置的全部理解都蒙上了一层阴影(而这理解本来就少得可怜)。

lines.en: Were they gone at all? Or were they just...temporarily invisible?
lines.zh: 她们真的消失过吗?还是只是……暂时隐形了?

lines.en: Would I have seen them if I had just used the thirty seconds it would have taken to peer into their rooms instead of acting out of fleeting nepotism and disregarding their existences in favor of someone else?
lines.zh: 如果我肯花上三十秒往她们房间里看一眼,而不是出于一时的偏袒就为了另一个人无视她们的存在,我是不是就能看见她们?

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: {i}None{/i} of us know, not even Maya.
lines.zh: 我们{i}谁也{/i}不知道,连 Maya 也不知道。

lines.en: But I guess that’s why she didn’t put up much of a fight when I was dragged along to another karaoke trip today.
lines.zh: 但我想,这就是为什么今天我被拖去又一次卡拉OK时,她没怎么反抗。

lines.en: And I guess that’s why she’s been cautiously staring at me for the last twenty minutes with her customary disdain replaced with concern.
lines.zh: 也想,这就是为什么过去二十分钟里她一直小心翼翼地盯着我看——那副惯常的轻蔑,被担忧取代了。

lines.en: : Can I help you with something?
lines.zh: : 有什么需要我帮忙的吗?

lines.en: : Can {i}I{/i} help you with something?
lines.zh: : 有什么需要{i}我{/i}帮忙的吗?

lines.en: : {i}Both{/i} of you can help me with something. The only issue is that I am a creature of habit and am not very good when it comes to actually asking for help.
lines.zh: : 你们{i}两个都{/i}有可以帮我的地方。唯一的问题是,我是个习惯的生物,而且很不擅长真正开口求人帮忙。

lines.en: : You ask me to help with your boxes all the time.
lines.zh: : 你明明三天两头让我帮你搬那些盒子。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke2
: I do not. That’s just something you happen to do of your own volition because, whether it be conscious or not, you are also a creature of habit.
lines.zh: : 我没有。那只是你自己乐意去做的事,因为不管你有没有意识到,你也是个习惯的生物。

lines.en: : Boxes?
lines.zh: : 盒子?

lines.en: : Yeah, she-
lines.zh: : 对啊,她——

lines.en: : Wait, didn’t you-
lines.zh: : 等等,你不是——

lines.en: : Pardon me for interrupting, but there are more pressing matters at hand than discussing which of my belongings I keep hidden.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下,但眼下还有比讨论我藏了哪些私人物件更要紧的事。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke3
: Are we allowed to talk about the end of the world around Ami and Uta?
lines.zh: : 我们能在 Ami 和 Uta 面前谈世界末日吗?

lines.en: : I normally just do it anyway. It’s not like they’re going to think we’re serious or anything.
lines.zh: : 我一般照样说。反正她们也不会当真。

lines.en: : Hey, Ami. The world is on repeat and Maya thinks I’m carrying Sensei’s baby.
lines.zh: : 嘿,Ami。世界在循环,而且 Maya 觉得我怀了 Sensei 的孩子。

lines.en: : First off, stop it.
lines.zh: : 首先,别说了。

lines.en: : Second, the two of them are so wrapped up in their own conversation that we could say {i}anything{/i} right now and it would likely go completely unnoticed.
lines.zh: : 其次,她们俩正聊得起劲,我们现在说{i}什么{/i}她们大概都完全注意不到。

lines.en: : Hey, Ami. Maya’s in love with-
lines.zh: : 嘿,Ami。Maya 爱上了——

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke4
: Thirdly, fuck off.
lines.zh: : 第三,滚一边去。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re not allowed to be mean to me anymore. We share a special bond now.
lines.zh: : 嘿,你以后不准再对我凶了。我们现在有了一种特别的羁绊。

lines.en: : The {i}bond{/i} we share has not changed in the slightest. You just happen to understand slightly more about our...{i}situation{/i} now.
lines.zh: : 我们之间的{i}羁绊{/i}一点都没变。你只是碰巧对我们的……{i}处境{/i}稍微多懂了一点。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke5
: I actually think I understand {i}less.{/i}
lines.zh: : 其实我觉得我懂得{i}更少{/i}了。

lines.en: : I’ll fill you in shortly. It’s just not something I can really gloss over in the time it takes to get from school to the karaoke bar.
lines.zh: : 我待会儿再跟你细说。这不是在从学校走到卡拉OK吧的这点时间里能三言两语带过的东西。

lines.en: : Which is why I suggest we make normal, human conversation for the time being rather than discussing things like boxes and time travel.
lines.zh: : 所以我建议,我们暂时聊点正常的人类对话,别去讨论什么盒子和时间旅行。

lines.en: : Wow, what a completely normal and human suggestion.
lines.zh: : 哇,多么正常、多么有人味的建议啊。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke6
: Or we can just not talk at all. That’s fine too.
lines.zh: : 或者我们也可以干脆什么都不说。那样也行。

lines.en: : I think we made her mad.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们把她惹毛了。

lines.en: : I’m not mad.
lines.zh: : 我没生气。

lines.en: : I have a feeling we’re going to be doing that a lot from now on since I finally have someone normal to talk to about all of this reset stuff.
lines.zh: : 我有预感,以后这种事会经常发生,毕竟我终于有个正常人可以聊这些重置的事了。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke7
: I am not {i}abnormal.{/i} I’m the most “normal” person here.
lines.zh: : 我{i}不正常{/i}。我是这里最「正常」的人。

lines.en: : Sensei! You’ve finally accepted my obsession and compulsion to be with you at all times as a normal character trait! I was beginning to think this day would never come!
lines.zh: : Sensei!你终于把我时时刻刻都想跟你黏在一起的执念和强迫症,当成正常的性格特质了!我还以为这一天永远不会来呢!

lines.en: : No matter how you look at it, something like that is a lot more common than godly powers that allow you to manipulate the world at will.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么看,那种东西总比能让你随心所欲操纵世界的神力要常见得多。

lines.en: : It is not {i}at will{/i} and there are no {i}powers.{/i} And since you apparently need to be reminded, anyone can-
lines.zh: : 那不是{i}随心所欲{/i},而且根本没有什么{i}神力{/i}。还有,既然你显然需要人提醒——任何人都能——

lines.en: : Maya, can you be quiet for a second? I’m trying to talk to Ayane right now.
lines.zh: : Maya,你能安静一秒吗?我现在正在跟 Ayane 说话。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke8
: You-
: Sensei! I {i}knew{/i} the apocalypse would bring us closer together!
lines.zh: : Sensei!我{i}就知道{/i}末日会让我们更亲近!

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke9
: Woah, what kinda conversation are we missin’ out on over there?
lines.zh: : 哇哦,你们那边在聊什么我们错过了的大事啊?

lines.en: : Apocalypse?
lines.zh: : 末日?

lines.en: : If you guys know something about the world ending, now’s the time to let the class know.
lines.zh: : 要是你们知道什么世界要完蛋的内幕,现在就赶紧向全班公开吧。

lines.en: : Oh, it already did. You don’t have to worry, Uta.
lines.zh: : 哦,已经完过啦。你不用担心,Uta。

lines.en: : Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么?

lines.en: : See? You’re getting the hang of this already, Ayane. Just keep being non-chalant about it and no one will ever realize you’re serious.
lines.zh: : 瞧?你已经上手了,Ayane。就这么继续漫不经心地说下去,没人会当真的。

lines.en: : Maya can also turn invisible and Sensei walks around the school naked sometimes.
lines.zh: : Maya 还能隐身,而且 Sensei 有时候会光着身子在学校里走来走去。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke10
: Is that how you found out? Did she see him and, like...tell you about it or something?
lines.zh: : 你就是这么发现的?她看到他了,然后……告诉了你之类的?

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Cool.
lines.zh: : 挺酷。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I guess I’m gonna go back to my conversation with Ami now.
lines.zh: : 我想我还是回去跟 Ami 聊天好了。

lines.en: : You guys sure talk about weird stuff when I’m not involved...
lines.zh: : 我不在场的时候,你们说的都是些奇怪的东西啊……

lines.en: scene black
Somehow or another, we manage to avoid making Maya mad for the rest of the walk to the karaoke bar.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的,在去卡拉OK吧剩下的路上,我们总算没再把 Maya 惹毛。

lines.en: But that’s probably just because she stays quiet until we finally make it there...
lines.zh: 不过那大概只是因为她在我们终于到那儿之前一直保持沉默……

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke11
She does open up again once we finally arrive, but it’s really just to fill in Ayane on all of the stuff I figured she would have been filled in on when she first made it to the roof.
lines.zh: 等我们终于到了,她确实又打开了话匣子,但多半只是把 Ayane 本该在第一次上天台时就被灌输的那些东西补齐。

lines.en: She goes over how it’s something that happens every four-ish months or so, but how it’s something she has to “feel” rather than something she can mark on her calendar.
lines.zh: 她讲了这件事大概每四个月左右会发生一次,可它更像是她必须去「感觉」的东西,而不是能在日历上标出来的东西。

lines.en: She goes over how the disappearance of everyone has stopped impacting her the way it did in the beginning.
lines.zh: 她讲了所有人消失这件事,已经不再像一开始那样影响她了。

lines.en: She goes over how the world is part of a never ending cycle that she alone has witnessed and that tampering with it has never yielded any meaningful results.
lines.zh: 她讲了世界是一个永无止境的循环的一部分,而她是唯一见证过它的人,并且任何对它的干预都从未产生过有意义的结果。

lines.en: But the one thing she goes over for longer than all of the others is the fact that something like {i}this{/i} has never happened.
lines.zh: 但她讲得比这些都久的,是「{i}这种{/i}事从来没有发生过」这个事实。

lines.en: And that throughout all of the time Maya has spent in these loops, Ayane and the rest of the girls have remained as mere pieces on a chess board, playing their part before ultimately being removed and packed away.
lines.zh: 以及在 Maya 经历过所有这些循环的全部时间里,Ayane 和其余的女孩始终只是棋盘上的棋子,演完自己的角色,然后被拿走、收进盒子里。

lines.en: She doesn’t know what this means. She makes that very clear.
lines.zh: 她不知道这意味着什么。这一点她说得非常清楚。

lines.en: Because of that, she wants to be careful.
lines.zh: 正因如此,她想谨慎行事。

lines.en: But while news like this would sound like utter nonsense to anyone else, Ayane listens closely and never once dismisses anything Maya says. I mean...why {i}would{/i} she at this point after all she’s seen?
lines.zh: 不过,虽然这种话在别人听来完全是胡说八道,Ayane 却听得很认真,一次也没有否定 Maya 说的任何话。我是说……在她亲眼见了这一切之后,她又怎么{i}会{/i}否定呢?

lines.en: This all happens while two other girls, loud and gleefully oblivious off in their own room, sing as if their pending removal from the chessboard we call life is not in store for them-
lines.zh: 这一切发生的时候,另外两个女孩正在她们自己的房间里,吵吵嚷嚷、快快活活地一无所知地唱着歌,仿佛「被从我们称之为人生的棋盘上拿走」这件事并没有在等着她们——

lines.en: And that it is impossible to dread anything if you are not acutely aware of it.
lines.zh: 而只要你对一件事没有清醒的认知,你就不可能去惧怕它。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke12
: I believe that about sums up the basics of our situation. So, if you have any questions, now would be the time to ask them.
lines.zh: : 我想这些差不多概括了我们处境的基本情况。所以,如果你有什么问题,现在就是提问的时候。

lines.en: : And...what if I have like, a million questions? Because I obviously believe you, but...there’s still a ton that I don’t get.
lines.zh: : 那……如果我有,比如说,一百万个问题呢?因为我显然相信你,可是……还是有一大堆我搞不懂。

lines.en: : Like...why {i}me?{/i} And if Sensei is the only other person who’s ever made it up to the roof with you, why him?
lines.zh: : 比如……为什么是{i}我{/i}?而且如果 Sensei 是唯一一个曾经跟你一起上天台的人,为什么是他?

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke13
: If I knew the answer to that, I would have included it in my speech just now.
lines.zh: : 如果我知道答案,刚才那番话里就一定已经说到了。

lines.en: : But the connection to Sensei is why I was and still {i}am{/i} confident about the reasoning that led to you joining us.
lines.zh: : 但和 Sensei 之间的联结,正{i}是{/i}我过去、现在都对你加入我们这件事的成因有信心的理由。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke14
: Even if that {i}was{/i} true, which it’s not, that wouldn’t explain why {i}you{/i} always make it to the roof.
lines.zh: : 就算那是{i}真的{/i}——可它不是——那也解释不了为什么{i}你{/i}每次都能上天台。

lines.en: : Unless you’ve been, like...secretly pregnant this whole time or something. Which would be both very weird and extremely offensive to me, the girl who actually {i}wants{/i} a baby.
lines.zh: : 除非你,比如说……一直偷偷怀着孕什么的。那对我来说既非常诡异,又极其冒犯,毕竟我才是那个真正{i}想要{/i}孩子的女孩。

lines.en: : I am decidedly not pregnant.
lines.zh: : 我明确地没有怀孕。

lines.en: : Neither am I, but you still don’t believe me.
lines.zh: : 我也没有,可你还是不信我。

lines.en: : Oh, I believe that you’re not pregnant {i}now.{/i} What I don’t believe is that you weren’t pregnant {i}then.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦,你{i}现在{/i}没怀孕我信。我不信的是你{i}那时候{/i}没怀孕。

lines.en: : Then as in-
lines.zh: : 那时候是指——

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke13
: When you made it to the roof.
lines.zh: : 你上天台的时候。

lines.en: : The first time? The one I don’t remember? Or-
lines.zh: : 第一次?我记不起来的那次?还是——

lines.en: : Both times.
lines.zh: : 两次都是。

lines.en: : So...what? The baby just...goes away once I respawn or something like that?
lines.zh: : 所以……什么?我一重生,孩子就……自己没了吗?或者类似的情况?

lines.en: : Or something like that.
lines.zh: : 或者类似的情况。

lines.en: : My theory is that Sensei’s lingering DNA inside of your system formed some sort of connection between the two of you that {i}tricked{/i} the world into believing you were an extension of him.
lines.zh: : 我的理论是,Sensei 残留在你体内的 DNA 在你们两人之间形成了某种联结,{i}骗{/i}得这个世界以为你是他的一部分延伸。

lines.en: : But then what about you? Or, wait- what about Ami? She has tons of Sensei’s DNA in her.
lines.zh: : 那你自己呢?或者,等等——那 Ami 呢?她体内可有一大堆 Sensei 的 DNA。

lines.en: : Please don’t say it like that.
lines.zh: : 别说得这么难听。

lines.en: : While that may be true, the link between them is a lot slimmer than that of a parent and child.
lines.zh: : 那也许是事实,但他们之间的联结,比父母与子女之间的要薄弱得多。

lines.en: : Well...what about you, then? How come you’re, like...patient zero?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那你自己呢?你怎么就……算是零号病人?

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke12
: Again, this is something I’d gladly share with you if I actually knew.
lines.zh: : 再说一次,如果我知道,我很乐意告诉你。

lines.en: : But the truth is that the vast majority of what has happened lately is brand new to me...and that all I can do is simply develop and test theories.
lines.zh: : 但事实是,最近发生的绝大部分事对我来说都是全新的……而我唯一能做的,就是提出并验证各种理论。

lines.en: : If something can be proven wrong, I am more than willing to accept it.
lines.zh: : 如果有什么能被证明是错的,我绝对乐于接受。

lines.en: : I {i}did{/i} prove the last one wrong, though! I really wasn’t-
lines.zh: : 可上一条我{i}已经证明{/i}是错的了啊!我真的没有——

lines.en: : I’m not calling you a liar. I’m saying you could have made a mistake or...whatever tests you took could have been...I don’t know- broken or something. That can happen, right?
lines.zh: : 我不是在说你撒谎。我是说你可能搞错了,或者……你做的那些检测有可能是……我不知道——坏了之类的。这种事是会发生的,对吧?

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke15
: Given how much time you’ve been doing this, I figured you would have had a better argument than “pregnancy tests can be broken.”
lines.zh: : 考虑到你已经做了这么久,我以为你能拿出比「验孕棒也会坏」更好的论据。

lines.en: : I’m sure if this was a thing that happened thousands of times before, I would. But the fact of the matter is that it hasn’t and I do not. So all I can do is guess.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定,如果这种事以前发生过几千次,我拿得出来。可事实是它没有发生过,所以我拿不出来。我能做的只有猜测。

lines.en: : If you have a better guess for why you made it to the roof multiple times, I’d be happy to hear it.
lines.zh: : 如果你对为什么你能多次上天台有更好的猜测,我很乐意听听。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke16
: Maybe it’s based on...how much we love Sensei?
lines.zh: : 也许取决于……我们有多爱 Sensei?

lines.en: : Maybe our love is just so powerful that the world-
lines.zh: : 也许我们的爱强烈到让这个世界——

lines.en: : Theory rejected. Love is not something that can be accurately quantified, so the idea of that being the single factor determining which consciousnesses are reset is laughable.
lines.zh: : 理论驳回。爱不是能被精确量化的东西,所以把它当作决定哪些意识会被重置的唯一因素,简直可笑。

lines.en: : Unless you’re actually able to test that theory, I suggest you put it to rest.
lines.zh: : 除非你真能去验证那个理论,否则我建议你还是把它放下。

lines.en: : We could always have a “Who loves Sensei more” competition.
lines.zh: : 我们倒是可以办一场「谁更爱 Sensei」大赛。

lines.en: : I concede. You win.
lines.zh: : 我认输。你赢了。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because you know you would have lost anyway.
lines.zh: : 你这么说,只是因为你知道反正你会输。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke13
: Yes. Sure.
lines.zh: : 对。当然。

lines.en: : Regardless, understanding {i}why{/i} Ayane made it to the roof could be the key to understanding...well, {i}anything{/i} about this world.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样,搞懂 Ayane {i}为什么{/i}能上天台,可能是搞懂……嗯,搞懂这个世界{i}任何一件事{/i}的关键。

lines.en: : If it’s something we can test, we have to test it.
lines.zh: : 如果这事可以验证,我们就必须去验证。

lines.en: : Which is why I’ve come up with a foolproof plan to confirm once and for all whether or not my theory is accurate.
lines.zh: : 正因如此,我想出了一个万无一失的计划,来一劳永逸地确认我的理论是否准确。

lines.en: : And that plan is?
lines.zh: : 那个计划是?

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke12
: The two of you can’t have sex until the next reset.
lines.zh: : 在下一次重置之前,你们两个不准做爱。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke17
scene postapocalypsekaraoke18
scene postapocalypsekaraoke19
: Do you have any other plans?
lines.zh: : 你还有别的计划吗?

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke20
: Are you kidding? I’ve been living in a never ending cycle for as long as I can remember that we have an opportunity to finally start understanding and {i}that{/i} is your response?
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑吧?从我记事起,我就一直活在一个永无止境的循环里,现在我们终于有机会开始弄明白它了,而你的反应就是{i}这个{/i}?

lines.en: : You see, I’ve just got a very high sex drive and-
lines.zh: : 你看,我只是性欲比较旺盛,而且——

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke21
: I don’t want to hear about your sex drive! I want to figure out what’s going on! Which, need I remind you, includes {i}you{/i} now!
lines.zh: : 我不想听{i}你{/i}的性欲!我想搞清楚到底发生了什么!而那,需要我提醒你吗,现在也包括你!

lines.en: : I...I know that! It’s just...well...this is all happening so quickly and...
lines.zh: : 我……我知道!只是……嗯……这一切发生得太快了,而且……

lines.en: : And...you see...my sex drive is-
lines.zh: : 而且……你看……我的性欲是——

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke22
: Can you shut up about your sex drive for one minute?!
lines.zh: : 你能不能闭嘴别提你的性欲,哪怕一分钟?!

lines.en: : Woah. I know Ayane’s pretty open about that sort of thing, but I didn’t really think we were at, like...intervention territory yet.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。我知道 Ayane 对那种事挺开放的,但我真没想到我们已经到了,比如说……要开干预大会的地步。

lines.en: : You know what? I’ll just head back in for one more song and let the three of you finish whatever this is.
lines.zh: : 这样吧,我再进去唱一首,你们三个把这事聊完。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke23
: Hah...
: We’ll resume this talk later...
lines.zh: : 这个话题我们晚点再接着聊……

lines.en: : But for the time being, {i}please{/i} take what I said into consideration.
lines.zh: : 不过眼下,{i}请{/i}把我说的放在心上。

lines.en: : It might sound “difficult” to you, but I am extremely serious about this.
lines.zh: : 在你听来也许「很难」,但我对这件事是极其认真的。

lines.en: : You, uhh...
: Tryin’ to help Ayane out with her sex drive, Maya?
lines.zh: : 想帮 Ayane 解决性欲问题吗,Maya?

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke24
: Today sucks. I am going to sing now.
lines.zh: : 今天真糟。我要去唱歌了。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke25
: I say just let her do it even if you’re not into girls, Ayane. She seems determined and confident and those are good qualities when it comes to that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 我说,就算你对女孩子没兴趣,就让她去吧,Ayane。她看起来又坚定又自信,而干那种事的时候,这些都是好品质。

lines.en: : She probably knows what she’s doing.
lines.zh: : 她大概知道自己在做什么。

lines.en: : I sure hope so...
lines.zh: : 我真希望如此……

lines.en: scene black
Ayane disappears into the room with Maya and Ami while Uta remains out in the hall with me, stopping me by grabbing my sleeve once I try to move past her...
lines.zh: Ayane 进了房间,和 Maya、Ami 在一起,而 Uta 留在外面走廊上跟我在一起,我试图从她身边走过去时,她一把抓住我的袖子,把我拦了下来……

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke26
: So, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……

lines.en: : Are you...not going to sing today, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你……今天不唱吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : You know, the last time I even {i}thought{/i} about doing that, some tiny girl with glasses tackled me and we almost kissed. Me staying away from the mic is the safest bet for everyone.
lines.zh: : 你是不知道,上一次我刚{i}动了{/i}这个念头,某个戴眼镜的小个子女孩就把我扑倒了,我们差点亲上。我离麦克风远一点,对大家来说都是最安全的选择。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke27
: Hahah...yeah...I guess when you put it that way...it makes sense...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是啊……你这么一说……好像也有道理……

lines.en: : Besides, you’ve got three whole girlfriends in there right now. Who knows what sort of stuff you’d get up to if any of them decided to...you know...{i}tackle{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 再说了,你里面现在可有三个女朋友呢。要是她们谁突然想……你知道的……{i}扑倒{/i}你,谁知道你们会搞出什么事来。

lines.en: : Even if what {i}I{/i} did was like 99%% accidental and wasn’t really a “tackle,” you know?
lines.zh: : 虽然{i}我{/i}那次大概有 99%% 是意外,而且也算不上什么「扑倒」,你懂的?

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke28
: A-Anyway! Enough about awkward past experiences and...things that would get me in trouble with the girls next door.
lines.zh: : 总……总之!别再提那些尴尬的过去了,还有……那些会让我在隔壁那几位姑娘面前惹上麻烦的事。

lines.en: : Are you excited for the whole...club swap thingy that’s going on?
lines.zh: : 你对正在搞的那个……社团大换血的事情感到兴奋吗?

lines.en: : Me? Not really. It doesn’t really impact me in any way.
lines.zh: : 我?不太。反正跟我没什么关系。

lines.en: : If anything, it might actually even save me some time after school since everyone will already be doing stuff and won’t have to come to me for counseling.
lines.zh: : 要说有什么影响,说不定反倒能帮我省下些放学后的时间,因为大家都有事做了,就不会再来找我咨询。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke29
: Well...{i}I’m{/i} excited.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}我{/i}挺兴奋的。

lines.en: : It’s been a while since I’ve done any of the stuff old Uta was into.
lines.zh: : 我已经很久没碰过去那个 Uta 喜欢的东西了。

lines.en: : And I’ve been feeling kinda...nostalgic lately...or something.
lines.zh: : 而且最近总觉得有点……怀旧……还是什么的。

lines.en: : Do you ever get like that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你也会有这种时候吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Do you ever feel like...I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 你会不会觉得……我不知道……

lines.en: : Like history is kind of repeating itself?
lines.zh: : 觉得历史好像在重演?

lines.en: : Probably not in the same way you do.
lines.zh: : 大概不会以跟你一样的方式。

lines.en: : Heh...yeah.
lines.zh: : 呵……是啊。

lines.en: : Probably not.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。

lines.en: scene postapocalypsekaraoke30
: E-Either way! I hope you’ll come see me in club sometime.
lines.zh: : 总……总之!我希望你有空能来社团看看我。

lines.en: : I might not be able to knock your socks off the way I do at the maid cafe, but I’m sure you’ll be impressed!
lines.zh: : 我也许没法像在女仆咖啡厅那样让你惊艳,但我敢肯定你会印象深刻的!

lines.en: : I’m sure I’ll be there a lot, but...I don’t think you’ve mentioned which club you’re joining yet.
lines.zh: : 我肯定会经常去的,不过……你好像还没说你要加入哪个社团。

lines.en: : That’s cause I’m still waiting on one other person to sign on. But seeing as her options are pretty limited, I’m confident I’ll get her to agree by the end of tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 因为我还在等另一个人签字。不过鉴于她的选择相当有限,我有信心明天之前能让她答应。

lines.en: : And if she doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 如果她不答应呢?

lines.en: : If she doesn’t...
lines.zh: : 如果她不答应……

lines.en: : Then she’s grown a lot more than I have.
lines.zh: : 那就说明她比我成长了更多。

lines.en: scene black
$ chapthree5 = True
$ uta_love += 1
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
I step into the bedroom to be met with an unfamiliar sensation.
lines.zh: 我走进卧室,迎面撞上一种陌生的感觉。

lines.en: A natural heat, not an artificial one brought on by the house’s radiators, permeates throughout the room and reminds me of why I was so thankful for the winter in the first place.
lines.zh: 一股自然的暑气——不是屋里暖气片造出来的那种人造的热——弥漫在整个房间里,让我想起来自己最初为什么会那么感激冬天。

lines.en: The trip back home from the karaoke bar was uneventful.
lines.zh: 从卡拉OK吧回家的路上,平淡无事。

lines.en: The dinner Ami made when we returned was uneventful.
lines.zh: 我们回去后 Ami 做的晚饭,平淡无事。

lines.en: Everything after what happened on the rooftop was uneventful.
lines.zh: 天台上那件事之后的一切,都平淡无事。

lines.en: But that’s okay.
lines.zh: 但这样就好。

lines.en: That’s okay.
lines.zh: 这样就好。

lines.en: Because everyone is still here.
lines.zh: 因为大家都还在这里。

lines.en: scene black
Because I am still here.
lines.zh: 因为我还在这里。
